Stuffed with aromatic seafood, the flavor can vary by ingredients but never disappoints.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can make Seafood Rice Balls by [[Cooking]] any [[Seafood]] together with [[Hylian Rice]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their default can be made either by using [[Hyrule Bass]]es or [[Sanke Carp]]s, which provide no status effects, or by using two types of Seafood with contradicting effects. When eaten, they will restore some of Link's [[Heart]]s. Though the flavor varies based on [[Ingredient]]s, Seafood Rice Balls are known to never disappoint. By using certain types of Seafood or adding extra Ingredients, the following variations of Seafood Rice Balls can be made: * '''Hearty Seafood Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Seafood Rice Balls}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Stuffed with aromatic seafood, the flavor can vary by ingredients but never disappoints.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Bass]], [[Hearty Salmon]]s, [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]]s, or other hearty Ingredients. By eating them, all of Link's Hearts will be healed, and he will gain temporary Hearts. * '''Energizing Seafood Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Seafood Rice Balls}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Stuffed with aromatic seafood, the flavor can vary by ingredients but never disappoints.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Staminoka Bass]]es, [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s, or other energizing Ingredients. They can be eaten to restore a part of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Enduring Seafood Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Seafood Rice Balls}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Stuffed with aromatic seafood, the flavor can vary by ingredients but never disappoints.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using enduring Ingredients. Link's Stamina Wheel will be completely replenished and overfilled when he eats these. * '''Hasty Seafood Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Seafood Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Stuffed with aromatic seafood, the flavor can vary by ingredients but never disappoints.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using hasty Ingredients. If consumed, Link will receive a boost to his movement speed. * '''Spicy Seafood Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Seafood Rice Balls}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
Stuffed with aromatic seafood, the flavor can vary by ingredients but never disappoints.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s or other spicy Ingredients. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Electro Seafood Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Seafood Rice Balls}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Stuffed with aromatic seafood, the flavor can vary by ingredients but never disappoints.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Voltfin Trout]] or other electric Ingredients. When eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Seafood Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Seafood Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Stuffed with aromatic seafood, the flavor can vary by ingredients but never disappoints.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Mighty Carp]], [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]], [[Razorclaw Crab]]s, or other mighty Ingredients. They can be eaten to grant Link a boost to his attack power. * '''Tough Seafood Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Seafood Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Stuffed with aromatic seafood, the flavor can vary by ingredients but never disappoints.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Armored Carp]], [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]], [[Ironshell Crab]]s, or other tough Ingredients. By eating them, Link's defensive abilities will be increased. * '''Sneaky Seafood Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Seafood Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Stuffed with aromatic seafood, the flavor can vary by ingredients but never disappoints.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Stealthfin Trout]]s, [[Sneaky River Snail]]s, or other sneaky Ingredients. Link can eat them to receive a boost to his [[Stealth]]. * '''Chilly Seafood Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Seafood Rice Balls}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
Stuffed with aromatic seafood, the flavor can vary by ingredients but never disappoints.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Chillfin Trout]]s or other chilly Ingredients. They can be consumed to offer Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Like in {{BotW}}, Seafood Rice Balls can be made by [[Cooking]] a bundle of [[Hylian Rice]] with any type of [[Seafood]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for Seafood Rice Balls is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[Fine Bites from Lurelin Village]]". It is made using four [[Stealthfin Trout]]s and four bundles of [[Tabantha Wheat]]. However, it can be lowered to three of each Ingredient through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Warrior]]s' [[Sheikah Rune]] damage will increase by 35%. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Seafood Rice Balls Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for Seafood Rice Balls ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Seafood Fried Rice }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Rice Balls, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
